title: Find out why effect-style-walk sometimes cannot find the Softness slider
goal: One of the scripted walks that checks saved effect styles fails now and then on a step that presses a slider called Softness, and passes on the next run of the same build. A walk that answers differently twice in a row is worse than no walk, because a real break in the panel would look like the same flake. Find out what makes it happen and make the walk answer the same way every time.
notes:
Seen 2026-09-12 while working on a-color-swatch-and-its-style-picker-sit-together.

Command:
  Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build style swatch

Output:
  effect-style-walk                          16s  FAILED  step 55 (press): no control called "Slider" in "Softness" is in the panel; the ones that are: none. A `panel` step lists everything.

"the ones that are: none" says the panel had NO controls at all at that moment, which reads more like the dock had not finished rebuilding than like the Softness row being gone. Re-ran the same walk three times against the same probe build (Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/effect-style-walk.json, twice with --no-build): ok, ok, ok. Could not reproduce, so it is filed as something to look into rather than as a bug.

Likely worth a wait or waitFor before step 55 in Scripts/playtest/effect-style-walk.json, but confirm what the panel is doing first rather than papering over it.
acceptance: The cause is named: what is on screen at that step when the press fails, and why the Softness slider is missing or unreachable then.
effect-style-walk passes five runs in a row on one build.
If the fault is in the app rather than in the walk, it is fixed rather than waited around.
